def rot_cw(g): return [list(row) for row in zip(*g[::-1])]
def rot_ccw(g): return [list(row) for row in zip(*g)][::-1]
def transform(g):
    cw=rot_cw(g); ccw=rot_ccw(g); half=rot_cw(cw)
    return [g[r]+cw[r] for r in range(len(g))] + [ccw[r]+half[r] for r in range(len(g))]
